entries.title: Job 22:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 22:2
segments: Is it possible for a man to be of profit to God? No, for a man's wisdom is only of profit to himself.

entries.title: Job 22:3
segments: Is it of any interest to the Ruler of all that you are upright? or is it of use to him that your ways are without sin?

entries.title: Job 22:4
segments: Is it because you give him honour that he is sending punishment on you and is judging you?

entries.title: Job 22:5
segments: ¶Is not your evil-doing great? and there is no end to your sins.

entries.title: Job 22:6
segments: For you have taken your brother's goods when he was not in your debt, and have taken away the clothing of those who have need of it.

entries.title: Job 22:7
segments: You do not give water to the tired traveller, and from him who has no food you keep back bread.

entries.title: Job 22:8
segments: For it was the man with power who had the land, and the man with an honoured name who was living in it.

entries.title: Job 22:9
segments: You have sent widows away without hearing their cause, and you have taken away the support of the child who has no father.

entries.title: Job 22:10
segments: For this cause nets are round your feet, and you are overcome with sudden fear.

entries.title: Job 22:11
segments: Your light is made dark so that you are unable to see, and you are covered by a mass of waters.

entries.title: Job 22:12
segments: Is not God as high as heaven? and see the stars, how high they are!

entries.title: Job 22:13
segments: And you say, What knowledge has God? is he able to give decisions through the deep dark?

entries.title: Job 22:14
segments: Thick clouds are covering him, so that he is unable to see; and he is walking on the arch of heaven.

entries.title: Job 22:15
segments: ¶Will you keep the old way by which evil men went?

entries.title: Job 22:16
segments: Who were violently taken away before their time, who were overcome by the rush of waters:

entries.title: Job 22:17
segments: Who said to God, Go away from us; and, What is the Ruler of all able to do to us?

entries.title: Job 22:18
segments: Though he made their houses full of good things: but the purpose of the evil-doers is far from me!

entries.title: Job 22:19
segments: The upright saw it and were glad: and those who had done no wrong made sport of them,

entries.title: Job 22:20
segments: Saying, Truly, their substance is cut off, and their wealth is food for the fire.

entries.title: Job 22:21
segments: ¶Put yourself now in a right relation with him and be at peace: so will you do well in your undertakings.

entries.title: Job 22:22
segments: Be pleased to take teaching from his mouth, and let his words be stored up in your heart.

entries.title: Job 22:23
segments: If you come back to the Ruler of all, making yourself low before him; if you put evil far away from your tents;

entries.title: Job 22:24
segments: And put your gold in the dust, even your gold of Ophir among the rocks of the valleys;

entries.title: Job 22:25
segments: Then the Ruler of all will be your gold, and his teaching will be your silver;

entries.title: Job 22:26
segments: For then you will have delight in the Ruler of all, and your face will be lifted up to God.

entries.title: Job 22:27
segments: You will make your prayer to him, and be answered; and you will give effect to your oaths.

entries.title: Job 22:28
segments: Your purposes will come about, and light will be shining on your ways.

entries.title: Job 22:29
segments: For God makes low those whose hearts are lifted up, but he is a saviour to the poor in spirit.

entries.title: Job 22:30
segments: He makes safe the man who is free from sin, and if your hands are clean, salvation will be yours.
